brand_dna.category: Craft cider club and Bristol Tap Room selling full-juice ciders from independent producers via subscription, online store, and events.
brand_dna.core_belief: On a mission to flood the towns and cities of the UK with delicious, not-from-concentrate cider made by the finest independent producers in the land.
proof_points: Full juice, not-from-concentrate cider from independent producers
Own site in St Phillip's, Bristol where they make small batches and run a Tap Room
Selected ciders are naturally vegan friendly and gluten-free (per product page)
brand_dna.positioning: Passionate craft-cider curator for indie drops, community-led and Bristol-rooted rather than mass-market or supermarket cider.

voice_pillars.name: Passionate Curator
voice_pillars.desc: Writes like a cider obsessive hunting down the best small-batch drops and championing indie makers.
voice_pillars.quote: We search high & low for the finest drops of fermented juices

voice_pillars.name: Community First
voice_pillars.desc: Invites people in - to drink together, taste together, and belong rather than just buy.
voice_pillars.quote: Enjoy at home, with us via online tastings, or at your own leisure & pleasure.

voice_pillars.name: Cheeky & Playful
voice_pillars.desc: Light, fun British tone with mascots and slang that keeps cider unpretentious.
voice_pillars.quote: Kingston, our cheeky apple-bod is seen here making a dash to the Tap Room

voice_pillars.name: Fresh & Local
voice_pillars.desc: Leans hard on freshness and Bristol roots as the reason to buy from them.
voice_pillars.quote: Full juice cider, fresh from Bristol's Cider Tap Room.

phrases: Fresh, modern cider from the best indie producers on the planet
presented with passion: We love The Cider Box
some familiar names and some new ones on me too- coming back soon

icp: UK-based cider enthusiasts, largely around Bristol, who value craft, independent producers, and freshness and buy to discover new small-batch ciders and share the experience.

personas.name: The Cider Explorer
personas.description: A curious drinker who wants to discover new indie producers and moves on the promise of familiar names plus fresh new drops.

personas.name: Bristol Local
personas.description: A city-dweller who values supporting a local Bristol maker and is moved by the Tap Room, events, and collect-in-store option.

personas.name: Experience Seeker
personas.description: A group organiser booking stag/hen, corporate, or tasting events who is moved by the community and hosted-tasting angle.

offers: Tap Room hire and events (Cider vs Cheese, Cider Bingo, tap takeovers, online tastings)
Summer 2026 tee ships with cider tokens for use at the bar
Newsletter with store updates and discounts

banned.claim: The best cider in the world / #1 cider club
banned.why: FTC - unqualified superlative that cannot be substantiated.

banned.claim: Guaranteed you'll love it or drink better than any other cider
banned.why: FTC - guaranteed-results claim that cannot be proven.

banned.claim: Citing invented review counts or star ratings
banned.why: FTC - no customer reviews were found; fabricated social proof is prohibited.

banned.claim: Only X boxes left - order in the next 10 minutes
banned.why: FTC - fake urgency/scarcity not backed by real stock or timers.

banned.claim: All our ciders are vegan and gluten-free
banned.why: Overbroad - only specific named ciders are stated as vegan and gluten-free, so it must be qualified per product.
Unsubstantiated health claim on an alcoholic product; not supported by site copy.
